images.actual_source_analysis: A plain closed blue rectangular door with a small round knob occupies the right-center of a red-brick building. One downward-facing dark metal wall lamp is directly above it, casting warm light onto the bricks and a damp paved foreground. A dark downpipe follows the building corner to the left of the door. A narrow alley recedes along the left side, with windows, shrubs and distant brick facades. Two potted shrubs flank the front wall, one near the downpipe and one at the right edge. Bare branches cross the blue-grey dusk sky at upper left; the paving has warm wet reflections.
